failure_summary.description: Stopped after verifying a small subset of candidates, missing qualifying offers across shops and among related product leads.
Appeared to require an explicit mention of GIFs, overlooking plausible display-capable models whose descriptions used related display terminology.
Submitted a URL for a different model than the one described in its notes, indicating the offer-to-URL mapping was not rechecked.

patch.reasoning: The skill already calls for cross-shop coverage and exact URL copying. These additions make candidate follow-up and feature interpretation more systematic, and require a final check that each submitted URL matches its verified offer.

edits.content:
## Verify Display-Capability Candidates

For attribute-based all-offers tasks, treat relevant products in related-product sections as leads to investigate, not as confirmed search results or reasons to stop searching. Open plausible candidates and assess the requested capability using product-specific descriptions and equivalent terminology; do not require an exact keyword match when the description or model specifications establish the same capability. Keep a per-shop list of candidates still to verify, and finish checking relevant candidates and result pages before concluding the search.

## Final Offer-to-URL Check

Before submission, verify each recorded offer against its own product page: confirm the retailer, product title, requested attributes, and exact current URL. Keep each URL paired with that verified offer, and do not infer a URL from a similar model or carry one forward after navigating to a different product.
